title: GitVault review contract
description: The declarative half of an audit checker: everything that varies per reviewer, as data. The runtime (Rust) executes these verbs; the registry pins and versions the document. Judgment stays in policy.md - natural language is not part of this schema.

domains.description: The coverage contract: every submit accounts for each domain as reviewed / not-applicable / unknown.

finding_keys.description: Every key a finding must carry, e.g. file/line/severity/evidence/impact/remedy/validation; Money Saver adds before_after and sources. file, line and severity are mandatory: the runtime validates every finding's path, positive line and severity enum.

surfaces.description: Stage-1 summaries carry a surfaces list (path/line/rule notices short of refusal) that the inventory reply and the receipt echo (Security Enhancer).

refusal.description: The error a stage-one refusal raises; defaults to the deterministic audit's refusal.

pattern.description: kind=regex: the deterministic pattern, run locally at zero token cost. An inline (?i) carries case-insensitivity.

target.description: kind=regex: what the pattern applies to - every line of the reviewed revision, the added or removed diff lines, or the path names the review carries.

prompt.description: kind=prompt: a judgement the reviewer must make, surfaced as a checklist item.

builtin.description: kind=builtin: a deterministic check the runtime ships as code; declared by name so the contract never carries executable text. Each builtin owns one coupled scan pass whose hit ordering and refusal priority are its semantics.

name_prefix.description: Tool names are derived: <prefix>_context, <prefix>_submit_review, <prefix>_official_doc. The prefix is data because the four published prefixes predate derivation and no rule reproduces them (sustainable-maintainer is 'maintainer').

context.description: The evidence verbs this reviewer may call in gate mode.

context_full_service.description: The verb list in full-service mode when it differs from gate mode (Sustainable Maintainer drops diff and adds original_request). Requires full_service=true; defaults to context.

official_documents.description: Whether the reviewer gets the catalogued official-document fetcher (Money Saver). Implies: the catalog in the inventory reply, findings' sources typed as catalogued URLs, submit validation that sources are fetched URLs and that applicable coverage cites at least one document, and the official_sources receipt field.

full_service.description: Whether an operator-assigned snapshot review over selected projects is available beside the gate. Implies per-project coverage in the submit contract, keyed by the snapshot's project labels.

projects_coverage.description: When the per-project coverage property appears in the submit manifest: only in full-service mode, or whenever full_service is offered. 'always' keeps one submit schema shape in both modes (Money Saver); the property is required only in full-service mode either way. Requires full_service=true.

domain_key.description: The key the inventory reply carries the domains under (Money Saver: cost_domains).

revision_label.description: The label the read operation uses for the reviewed end of the range (Money Saver: staged).

context_full_service.description: The context tool's description in full-service mode; defaults to context.

inventory_full_service.description: The inventory reply's instruction text in full-service mode; requires full_service=true.

descriptions.description: The model-facing tool descriptions. {read_page_lines}, {diff_page_chars} and {find_page} placeholders are filled by the runtime, so a page-size change cannot leave a description promising a page the code no longer serves.

finding_optional_keys.description: Finding properties accepted but not required, typed as plain strings (Money Saver: title). They must not duplicate finding_keys. A finding key named 'sources' under tools.official_documents=true is instead typed as a list of catalogued URLs.

task.description: The instruction template the runtime prepends to the review conversation; {placeholders} name runtime facts, never repository content.

task_full_service.description: The instruction template in full-service mode; defaults to task.

manifests.description: Exact file names the snapshot includes regardless of suffix.

exclude_names.description: Exact base names excluded beyond the engine's shared hygiene set (Sustainable Maintainer excludes lockfiles: generated integrity data, not reviewable structure).

snapshot.description: The file contract of a full-service snapshot: which files the reviewer may read. Requires tools.full_service=true. The runtime's shared hygiene (vendored/build/cache directories, generated suffixes, the sensitive-path contract) always applies and is not repeated here.

fallback_models.description: Ordered same-agent model fallbacks behind `model`; the audit session steps down this list when the active model cannot serve the turn.

runtime.description: Inert labels only - never a command, path or endpoint. The runtime rejects anything outside the declared set.
